name: ZeroB AS2 - Water Softener-2000LPH
summary: Auto Soft 2 converts hard water into soft water and comes with distinctive Purple Resin Media.
intro: Auto Soft 2 converts hard water into soft water with distinctive Purple Resin Media at flow rates of 2000 LPH, improving bathing, washing and laundering while eliminating scum formation and scaling effects of hard water on appliances and bathroom accessories.
features: Fully automatic programmable process valve with zero manual intervention
Softens water and prevents scale, scum and corrosion damage to bathroom fittings and appliances
Reduces detergent and soap consumption while protecting fabric colour and texture
Increases the lifespan of washing machines, water heaters and other appliances
Uses ZeroB's proprietary Purple Resin Media (RESIN Technology)
